+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import assemblyai as aai
+
+
+@dataclass
+class RecognitionEvent:
+    text: str
+    is_final: bool
+    confidence: Optional[float] = None
+    words: Optional[List[Dict[str, Any]]] = None
+
+
+class PartialResultsHandler:
+    def __init__(self, api_key: Optional[str] = None) -> None:
+        self.api_key = api_key or os.environ.get("ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY")
+        if not self.api_key:
+            raise ValueError("ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY is required")
+        aai.settings.api_key = self.api_key
+
+    def handle_event(self, event: Dict[str, Any]) -> RecognitionEvent:
+        text = str(event.get("text", "")).strip()
+        is_final = bool(event.get("message_type") == "FinalTranscript" or event.get("is_final"))
+        confidence = event.get("confidence")
+        words = event.get("words")
+        return RecognitionEvent(text=text, is_final=is_final, confidence=confidence, words=words)
+
+    def process_stream(self, stream: Any) -> List[RecognitionEvent]:
+        results: List[RecognitionEvent] = []
+        for event in stream:
+            results.append(self.handle_event(event))
+        return results
+
+
+def build_assemblyai_transcriber(sample_rate: int = 16000) -> aai.RealtimeTranscriber:
+    return aai.RealtimeTranscriber(sample_rate=sample_rate)
+

+import asyncio
+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import AsyncIterator, Optional
+
+import httpx
+
+
+OPENAI_AUDIO_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/transcriptions"
+
+
+@dataclass
+class AudioChunk:
+    index: int
+    data: bytes
+
+
+async def stream_audio_chunks(source: AsyncIterator[bytes], chunk_size: int = 65536) -> AsyncIterator[AudioChunk]:
+    index = 0
+    buffer = bytearray()
+    async for item in source:
+        buffer.extend(item)
+        while len(buffer) >= chunk_size:
+            yield AudioChunk(index=index, data=bytes(buffer[:chunk_size]))
+            del buffer[:chunk_size]
+            index += 1
+    if buffer:
+        yield AudioChunk(index=index, data=bytes(buffer))
+
+
+async def transcribe_streamed_chunks(source: AsyncIterator[bytes], model: str = "gpt-4o-mini-transcribe") -> AsyncIterator[str]:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}"}
+    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=60.0) as client:
+        async for chunk in stream_audio_chunks(source):
+            files = {"file": (f"chunk-{chunk.index}.wav", chunk.data, "audio/wav")}
+            data = {"model": model}
+            response = await client.post(OPENAI_AUDIO_API_URL, headers=headers, data=data, files=files)
+            response.raise_for_status()
+            yield response.json().get("text", "")
+
+
+async def _example_source() -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:
+    for _ in range(3):
+        await asyncio.sleep(0)
+        yield b"\x00" * 24000
+
+
+async def main() -> None:
+    async for text in transcribe_streamed_chunks(_example_source()):
+        if text:
+            print(text)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    asyncio.run(main())
*** End Patch

+import asyncio
+import json
+import os
+import queue
+import threading
+from typing import AsyncGenerator, Optional
+
+import sounddevice as sd
+from deepgram import DeepgramClient, LiveOptions, LiveTranscriptionEvents
+
+
+class MicrophoneTranscriptStream:
+    def __init__(self, model: str = "nova-2", sample_rate: int = 16000, channels: int = 1) -> None:
+        self.model = model
+        self.sample_rate = sample_rate
+        self.channels = channels
+        self._audio_queue: "queue.Queue[bytes]" = queue.Queue()
+        self._stop_event = threading.Event()
+
+    def _audio_callback(self, indata, frames, time, status) -> None:
+        if status:
+            pass
+        self._audio_queue.put(bytes(indata))
+
+    async def stream(self) -> AsyncGenerator[str, None]:
+        api_key = os.environ.get("DEEPGRAM_API_KEY")
+        if not api_key:
+            raise RuntimeError("DEEPGRAM_API_KEY is required")
+
+        client = DeepgramClient(api_key)
+        connection = client.listen.asynclive.v("1")
+
+        loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
+        transcript_queue: "asyncio.Queue[Optional[str]]" = asyncio.Queue()
+
+        def on_message(_, result, **kwargs) -> None:
+            try:
+                payload = json.loads(result.to_json()) if hasattr(result, "to_json") else result
+                channel = payload.get("channel", {})
+                alternatives = channel.get("alternatives", [])
+                transcript = alternatives[0].get("transcript", "") if alternatives else ""
+                if transcript:
+                    loop.call_soon_threadsafe(transcript_queue.put_nowait, transcript)
+            except Exception:
+                return
+
+        def on_close(_, **kwargs) -> None:
+            loop.call_soon_threadsafe(transcript_queue.put_nowait, None)
+
+        connection.on(LiveTranscriptionEvents.Transcript, on_message)
+        connection.on(LiveTranscriptionEvents.Close, on_close)
+
+        options = LiveOptions(
+            model=self.model,
+            language="en-US",
+            smart_format=True,
+            interim_results=True,
+            punctuate=True,
+            encoding="linear16",
+            channels=self.channels,
+            sample_rate=self.sample_rate,
+        )
+
+        await connection.start(options)
+
+        def mic_worker() -> None:
+            with sd.RawInputStream(
+                samplerate=self.sample_rate,
+                blocksize=8000,
+                channels=self.channels,
+                dtype="int16",
+                callback=self._audio_callback,
+            ):
+                while not self._stop_event.is_set():
+                    try:
+                        data = self._audio_queue.get(timeout=0.1)
+                    except queue.Empty:
+                        continue
+                    asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(connection.send(data), loop)
+
+        worker = threading.Thread(target=mic_worker, daemon=True)
+        worker.start()
+
+        try:
+            while True:
+                item = await transcript_queue.get()
+                if item is None:
+                    break
+                yield item
+        finally:
+            self._stop_event.set()
+            try:
+                await connection.finish()
+            except Exception:
+                pass
+
+
+async def stream_microphone() -> AsyncGenerator[str, None]:
+    async for transcript in MicrophoneTranscriptStream().stream():
+        yield transcript
+
*** End Patch
